title: The Horse That Did Math. Sort Of 🐴
caption:
This horse could do math. Or could he? 🐴
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In early-1900s Berlin, Clever Hans seemed to answer arithmetic questions by tapping his hoof. In 1907 psychologist Oskar Pfungst showed Hans was reading tiny, unintentional cues in the questioner's face and posture.
Is your pet a genius or a face reader? 👇
first_comment: He failed math but aced reading people. Honestly the more useful skill. 🐴👇
